description: Source code implementing platform-specific functions to extract CPU context and register states from ucontext structures for different architectures (x86, x86_64, ARM, AArch64, MIPS) in the Google Breakpad project.

methods.name: GetStackPointer
methods.description: Returns the stack pointer from the ucontext structure for the specific architecture.

methods.name: GetInstructionPointer
methods.description: Returns the instruction pointer (program counter) from the ucontext structure for the specific architecture.

methods.name: FillCPUContext
methods.description: Fills a RawContextCPU structure with register values extracted from the ucontext structure for the specific architecture.
